$comment: Documentation + catalog SoT for PDL built-in symbols (token types, supplemental enums, constructors, protocols, relationships). Frame property tables and host-enum cases used by the compilers remain in shared/frame-props.json — the doc generator merges both. Do not duplicate host enum cases here; list only enums not encoded in frame-props valueKinds.

paramScalars.name: String
paramScalars.notes: Not a token type — param and value-let only.

paramScalars.name: Number
paramScalars.notes: Not a token type — param and value-let only.

tokenTypes.name: Distance
tokenTypes.rhs: Non-negative number; semantic may alias Distance.

tokenTypes.name: Icon
tokenTypes.notes: Frame ctor `Icon(…)` builds an icon **frame** — different namespace.

tokenTypes.name: MediaSource
tokenTypes.rhs: `MediaSource(file:…|url:… [, kind:, format:])`, pack path, or http(s) URL.

tokenTypes.name: LineHeight
tokenTypes.summary: Leading as a unitless ratio of fontSize.

tokenTypes.name: EdgeInsets
tokenTypes.rhs: `EdgeInsets(x:, y:)` or TRBL; number sugar → uniform.

tokenTypes.name: CornerRadii
tokenTypes.notes: Constructor name stays `Corner`; type name is `CornerRadii`.

tokenTypes.name: Media
tokenTypes.notes: Distinct from `MediaSource` and from the `Media(…)` **frame** ctor.

tokenTypes.name: Background
tokenTypes.rhs: Scalar Color sugar or layer array — same shape as Foreground.

enums.name: BlurStyle
enums.notes: Host enum; more cases (gaussian, bokeh, …) reserved for later. Not in frame-props.json.

enums.name: MediaKind
enums.summary: Media role on `MediaSource` (`kind:`); bake IR field `mediaKind`.

enums.name: TextFieldActivation
enums.notes: Prelude variant for EditableText injected state.

enums.name: SizingMode
enums.summary: Keyword modes for the `Sizing` type (not a host enum table).

frameKinds.name: layout
frameKinds.summary: Flex-like container: direction, gap, padding, layers, sizing.

frameKinds.name: text
frameKinds.summary: Typography + optional typeStyle; optional editable root with EditableText.

frameKinds.name: icon
frameKinds.notes: Distinct from `IconRef` (asset value) and token type `Icon`.

constructors.name: Layout
constructors.summary: World A frame ctor for layout frames.

constructors.name: Text
constructors.summary: World A frame ctor for text frames.

constructors.name: Icon
constructors.summary: World A frame ctor for icon frames.

constructors.name: Media
constructors.summary: World A frame ctor for media frames.

constructors.name: Spacer
constructors.summary: Expands on the main axis inside `children`.
constructors.notes: Not a frame kind; `Spacer() @ …` is illegal.

constructors.name: EdgeInsets
constructors.signature: EdgeInsets(x:, y:) | EdgeInsets(top:, right:, bottom:, left:)

constructors.name: MediaSource
constructors.signature: MediaSource(file: "…" [, kind:, format:]) | MediaSource(url: "…" [, kind:, format:])

constructors.name: Color
constructors.notes: Bare hex / Color token sugar also valid in layer stacks.

protocols.name: PointerInput
protocols.summary: Pointer, focus, and lifecycle inbound channels from the host environment.

protocols.name: EditableText
protocols.summary: Text editing session channels and host verbs; pairs with kind `text`.

errors.name: unexpected-token
errors.summary: Unexpected token in the current parse context (also used for removed keywords like `interaction` / classic `let`).

errors.name: circular-import
errors.summary: Import chain forms a cycle.

errors.name: duplicate-symbol
errors.summary: Two top-level declarations share a name in the same namespace.

errors.name: unknown-token-type
errors.summary: Unknown TokenType on a primitive/semantic.

errors.name: token-type-mismatch
errors.summary: Token RHS incompatible with declared TokenType.

errors.name: frame-prop-type-mismatch
errors.summary: Frame / typeStyle property value has the wrong type.

errors.name: unresolved-reference
errors.summary: Identifier does not resolve to a token, param, or frame id.

errors.name: unresolved-type-style
errors.summary: `style = Name` does not match a typeStyle.

errors.name: retired
errors.summary: Formerly interaction-for; do not emit.

errors.name: invalid-condition-operand
errors.summary: Condition compares unsupported types or operators.

errors.name: unknown-frame-property
errors.summary: Property not defined on that frame kind / typeStyle.

errors.name: invalid-frame-prop-target
errors.summary: Unknown frame id, wrong-kind prop, or illegal fixture param ref.

errors.name: circular-token-reference
errors.summary: Token RHS cycle.

errors.name: duplicate-fixture-label
errors.summary: Duplicate example label in fixtures.

errors.name: retired
errors.summary: Formerly expose-unknown-param; expose removed.

errors.name: extend-unknown-target
errors.summary: extend names a missing component.

errors.name: quoted-hex-color
errors.summary: Quoted string used where unquoted hex Color is required.

errors.name: reserved-word-as-identifier
errors.summary: Reserved word used as a user identifier.

errors.name: invalid-override-target
errors.summary: Forward reference to undeclared let frame id.

errors.name: invalid-constructor-arg
errors.summary: Constructor / pack argument error.

errors.name: duplicate-let-frame-id
errors.summary: Duplicate let / letInstance id in a component.

errors.name: unknown-protocol
errors.summary: Unknown protocol name.

errors.name: unknown-foreach-list
errors.summary: ForEach names a non-list param.

errors.name: unknown-emit-channel
errors.summary: Unknown emit channel.

errors.name: invalid-foreach-binding
errors.summary: Invalid ForEach derived bind.

errors.name: foreach-chrome-unimplemented
errors.summary: before/between/after before B6.

errors.name: emit-payload-mismatch
errors.summary: Emit capture / fire arity or types mismatch.

errors.name: ambient-as-emit-capture
errors.summary: Host inbound used as child emit capture.

errors.name: declared-as-host-channel
errors.summary: Declared emit used as host inbound channel.

errors.name: interaction-missing-host-protocol
errors.summary: Host channel/verb without effective host conformance.

errors.name: host-protocol-as-slot-type
errors.summary: Host protocol used as slot/param type.

errors.name: invalid-protocol-requires
errors.summary: Invalid requires clause on a protocol.

errors.name: unknown-host-verb
errors.summary: Unknown host verb in a handler.

errors.name: array-slot-dotted-override
errors.summary: Dotted override on an array slot; use ForEach.

errors.name: foreach-without-mount
errors.summary: ForEach list never mounted via children.

errors.name: list-emit-capture
errors.summary: Emit capture on a list param; use ForEach binder.

errors.name: unknown-component
errors.summary: Unknown component name.

errors.name: mixed-condition-operators
errors.summary: Mixed && and || without parentheses.

errors.name: unknown-param-type
errors.summary: Unknown param type; Boolean → use Bool.

errors.name: param-type-mismatch
errors.summary: Param default / kwarg / fixture type mismatch.

errors.name: unknown-sample-path
errors.summary: Unknown samples bank/entry/field or bank/component name collision.

errors.name: param-shadows-token
errors.summary: Param name matches a token; param wins in body.

errors.name: primitive-token-in-component
errors.summary: Component references a primitive token directly.

errors.name: literal-opacity-in-library
errors.summary: Raw opacity literal where an Opacity token is preferred.

errors.name: unreadable-schemaVersion
errors.summary: Unknown schemaVersion on catalogue/manifest input.

errors.name: unknown-key-in-usage
errors.summary: usage block key other than description.

errors.name: empty-component
errors.summary: Root frame has no children and no content props.

errors.name: unreachable-override-branch
errors.summary: Unreachable if/else if branch.

errors.name: retired
errors.summary: Formerly interaction-targets-unexposed-param.
